items.html: And there is yet a third light, and it is necessary, (27) for when the light of the eye descends and expands downward through the Akudim, it looks at those lights of AHP, and draws from there and takes light from them for the need of making the vessels of the Nekudot; and it takes from three lights, which are the lights of Ozen, Hotem, and Peh.
